Definition
[Topological end] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0206, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0207 1. ch31:31.31\group Hyperbolic ends

A compact set $K$ is end-complementary if components of complements stabilize under enlargement of $K$. Such stabilized components are the topological ends of a noncompact manifold.
